title: QURL Operations
description: HTTP RED metrics, SLOs, and infrastructure health for QURL API service

targets.expr: (1 - ((sum(increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="qurl-api", deployment_environment="$environment", cell_id=~"$cell_id", http_status_code=~"5.."}[30d])) or vector(0)) / sum(increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="qurl-api", deployment_environment="$environment", cell_id=~"$cell_id"}[30d])))) * 100

clamp_min(100 * (1 - (((sum(increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="qurl-api", deployment_environment="$environment", cell_id=~"$cell_id", http_status_code=~"5.."}[30d])) or vector(0)) / sum(increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="qurl-api", deployment_environment="$environment", cell_id=~"$cell_id"}[30d]))) / (1 - $slo_target/100))), 0)

panels.title: Burn Rate (1h)
panels.description: How fast error budget is being consumed. >1 = burning faster than sustainable, >14.4 = will exhaust 30d budget in 1h

targets.expr: (sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="qurl-api", deployment_environment="$environment", cell_id=~"$cell_id", http_status_code=~"5.."}[1h])) / sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="qurl-api", deployment_environment="$environment", cell_id=~"$cell_id"}[1h]))) / (1 - $slo_target/100) or vector(0)

panels.title: 5xx Count (1h)
panels.description: Total 5xx errors in the last hour

targets.expr: sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="qurl-api", deployment_environment="$environment", cell_id=~"$cell_id", http_status_code=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="qurl-api", deployment_environment="$environment", cell_id=~"$cell_id"}[5m])) * 100 or vector(0)

sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="qurl-api", deployment_environment="$environment", cell_id=~"$cell_id", http_status_code=~"4.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="qurl-api", deployment_environment="$environment", cell_id=~"$cell_id"}[5m])) * 100 or vector(0)

panels.title: p999 Latency
panels.description: 99.9th percentile request latency over 5m window. Action: If > 2s, check DynamoDB latency, Auth0 validation, and container resource usage.

panels.title: Apdex Score
panels.description: Application Performance Index. Satisfied: <$${latency_slo_ms}ms, Tolerating: <4x SLO, Frustrated: >4x SLO. Score 1.0 = all satisfied, <0.5 = poor experience. Action: If < 0.85, investigate latency outliers.

targets.expr: (sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name="qurl-api", deployment_environment="$environment", cell_id=~"$cell_id", le=~"$${latency_slo_ms}e-03|0.$${latency_slo_ms}"}[5m])) + sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name="qurl-api", deployment_environment="$environment", cell_id=~"$cell_id", le=~"$${latency_slo_ms}e-03|0.$${latency_slo_ms}"}[5m])) / 2) / sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="qurl-api", deployment_environment="$environment", cell_id=~"$cell_id"}[5m])) or vector(1)

panels.title: Burn Rate (6h)
panels.description: 6-hour error budget burn rate. >6 = page-level alert (will exhaust budget in 5 days at this rate).

targets.expr: (sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="qurl-api", deployment_environment="$environment", cell_id=~"$cell_id", http_status_code=~"5.."}[6h])) / sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="qurl-api", deployment_environment="$environment", cell_id=~"$cell_id"}[6h]))) / (1 - $slo_target/100) or vector(0)

panels.title: Burn Rate (3d)
panels.description: 3-day error budget burn rate. >1 = ticket-level alert (slow burn, will exhaust budget within the month).

targets.expr: (sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="qurl-api", deployment_environment="$environment", cell_id=~"$cell_id", http_status_code=~"5.."}[3d])) / sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="qurl-api", deployment_environment="$environment", cell_id=~"$cell_id"}[3d]))) / (1 - $slo_target/100) or vector(0)

panels.title: Error Budget Consumption (30d)
panels.description: Error budget remaining over time. Downward slope = budget being consumed. Action: If trajectory hits 0 before month end, investigate error sources.

targets.expr: clamp_min(100 * (1 - (((sum(increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="qurl-api", deployment_environment="$environment", cell_id=~"$cell_id", http_status_code=~"5.."}[30d])) or vector(0)) / sum(increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="qurl-api", deployment_environment="$environment", cell_id=~"$cell_id"}[30d]))) / (1 - $slo_target/100))), 0)

panels.title: Requests by Endpoint
panels.description: Top 10 endpoints by request volume with error rate. Action: Endpoints with > 5% error rate warrant investigation.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (http_route, http_method) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="qurl-api", deployment_environment="$environment", cell_id=~"$cell_id"}[1h])))

sum by (http_route, http_method) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="qurl-api", deployment_environment="$environment", cell_id=~"$cell_id", http_status_code=~"5.."}[1h])) / sum by (http_route, http_method) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="qurl-api", deployment_environment="$environment", cell_id=~"$cell_id"}[1h])) * 100 or vector(0)

sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="qurl-api", deployment_environment="$environment", cell_id=~"$cell_id", http_status_code=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="qurl-api", deployment_environment="$environment", cell_id=~"$cell_id"}[5m])) * 100 or vector(0)

sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="qurl-api", deployment_environment="$environment", cell_id=~"$cell_id", http_status_code=~"4.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="qurl-api", deployment_environment="$environment", cell_id=~"$cell_id"}[5m])) * 100 or vector(0)

topk(10, sum by (http_route, http_status_code) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="qurl-api", deployment_environment="$environment", cell_id=~"$cell_id", http_status_code=~"[45].."}[1h])))

panels.title: Error Rate by Endpoint
panels.description: Per-endpoint 5xx error rate over time. Helps identify which endpoints are contributing most to SLO burn. Action: Focus on endpoints with sustained > 1% error rate.

targets.expr: topk(5, sum by (http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="qurl-api", deployment_environment="$environment", cell_id=~"$cell_id", http_status_code=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum by (http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="qurl-api", deployment_environment="$environment", cell_id=~"$cell_id"}[5m])) * 100)

panels.title: Latency by Endpoint (p999)
panels.description: Per-endpoint 99.9th percentile latency over time. Identifies which endpoints contribute to tail latency. Action: Endpoints consistently > 2s need profiling or caching.

targets.expr: topk(5, histogram_quantile(0.999, sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name="qurl-api", deployment_environment="$environment", cell_id=~"$cell_id"}[5m])) by (le, http_route)) * 1000 > 0)

panels.title: Slowest Endpoints (p999)
panels.description: Top 10 endpoints by 99.9th percentile latency. Action: Investigate endpoints > 3s for slow DB queries or external calls.

targets.expr: topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.999, sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name="qurl-api", deployment_environment="$environment", cell_id=~"$cell_id"}[1h])) by (le, http_route, http_method)) * 1000 > 0)

panels.title: DynamoDB Latency by Operation
panels.description: DynamoDB operation latency at p95/p99/p999. Action: If p999 > 500ms, check for throttling, hot partitions, or large item sizes.

panels.title: DynamoDB Failed Operations
panels.description: DynamoDB operations that returned errors (includes throttles, validation errors, etc). Action: If sustained, check table capacity, hot partition keys, or item size limits.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (http_route) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="qurl-api", deployment_environment="$environment", cell_id=~"$cell_id", http_status_code="429"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Recent Error Logs
panels.description: Error-level log entries from the QURL API service. Shows the most recent errors with timestamp and message. Action: investigate recurring errors or error spikes after deployments.

targets.expression:
fields @timestamp, @message
| filter @message like /(?i)(ERROR|FATAL|panic)/
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 200

panels.title: QURL Log Volume
panels.description: QURL API service log lines per 5 minutes. Useful for spotting error spikes or unusual log volume after deployments.

targets.expression:
fields @timestamp, @message
| stats count(*) as log_lines by bin(5m)

panels.title: qURL Resolve (NHP)
panels.description: Server-side and browser-side observability for /plugins/qurl resolve. Metrics live in the LayerV/NHP CloudWatch namespace; see per-panel descriptions for read-the-graph guidance, threshold rationale, and the $cell_id provenance caveat.

panels.title: qURL Resolve p999 (server-side)
panels.description: Server-side p999 latency for the /plugins/qurl resolve endpoint. Overall = total handler duration; Token-validate = Auth0 introspection; Knock = all knock attempts + inter-attempt retry sleeps; Knock-attempt = a single AuthWithHttpCallback invocation (the wire knock + post-knock wait that one attempt does). A spike in Knock with stable Knock-attempt means retries are doing the work; a Knock-attempt spike points at AC/NHP itself. Period: 300s to match the existing KnockLatency panels in nhp-infrastructure.json — at sandbox traffic rates, 60s p99.9 buckets are too sparse. No thresholds: the four metrics are nested (Overall = TokenValidate + Knock + handler work), so any uniform threshold would either trip on Overall in steady state (Auth0 tail + knock tail are additive) or under-fire on the components. Read the lines. At <200 req/min the 5-min p99.9 bucket holds <1000 samples and the percentile is mathematically max-dominated — treat it as an outlier detector at sandbox traffic, not a true tail. Cell filter: $cell_id is sourced from qurl-api Prometheus labels and piped here into the CloudWatch Cell dim on NHP server metrics; this works because qurl-api and nhp-server in any given env are deployed from the same per-cell tfvars and share the cell0/cell1/... naming. A future divergence would silently produce empty panels — same caveat applies to every CloudWatch panel in nhp-infrastructure.json.

panels.title: Browser Timing Per-Phase (p999)
panels.description: p999 of the six browser-side phases the qurl.link SPA reports as t_*_ms form fields (nhp PR #1842): DNS, TCP, TLS, TTFB, DOM-interactive, JS time-to-submit. Zero observations across every phase = the SPA's instrumentation regressed (see tests/smoke/16_qurl_link_frontend_test.go). No thresholds: the six phases live on radically different scales (DNS/TCP/TLS p999 typically <100ms; DOMInteractive and TimeToSubmit legitimately 500–2000ms on normal page loads), so a single threshold misleads more than it helps — read the lines. Y-axis is log10 so all six phases show meaningful variance on one panel despite the ~100× scale spread. At <200 req/min the 5-min p99.9 bucket holds <1000 samples and the percentile is mathematically max-dominated — treat it as an outlier detector at sandbox traffic, not a true tail.

panels.title: Resolve Outcomes & Knock Retries
panels.description: Sum (per 5-min CloudWatch period) of resolve outcomes: Success vs each terminal failure (Fail{Validate,Knock,PostKnock,Canceled,Unknown}), plus KnockRetry. KnockRetry increments once per failed knock attempt that still has retries remaining — a resolve succeeding on attempt 3 contributes 2; a resolve failing all attempts contributes (knockMaxAttempts - 1) and drags FailKnock up with it. Reading: a KnockRetry spike with Success flat and FailKnock flat means retries are silently masking transient AC flakiness — investigate the underlying knock-attempt latency. FailCanceled rising (NOT FailKnock) is the "retries gave up early" signal — it means the request context died mid-retry-loop. Eyeball error rate by comparing the Fail* lines against the Success line on the same axes. Quiet periods show as no line at all (CloudWatch returns gaps, not zeros, for absent observations); 'no line' is not a broken metric. Browser-side validation rejections (QurlResolveBrowserRejected{Malformed,OutOfRange}) are tracked separately in CloudWatch and not surfaced here yet. Colors are pinned (Success green; Fail* warm red/orange; KnockRetry yellow) so an operator scanning the panel sees a red/orange swell without reading labels.
